name: v2link
description: 临时 VLESS 链接生成与分发管理系统 —— 控制面 Node/TS + SQLite，数据面 xray（xray api 热管理，零 reload）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.format: npm run format -w server && npm run format -w frontend
